Department:  Public Works
Submitted by:  Daniel S. Wall, P.E., Director of Public Works

Subject
Quarterly City Housing Report

Recommendation
Receive and file the June 2023 Quarterly Housing Report.

Background
Staff will present the Quarterly City Housing Report for the period from March 2023 through May
2023. The report highlights rent, occupancy, inspections, and repairs. In conjunction with the
quarterly update, City staff will provide the commission a summary of housing related inquiries.

Fiscal Impact
There is no fiscal impact associated with this report.

3.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommendation: Approve the December 14, 2022 Regular Vernon Housing
  Commission meeting minutes.

 NEW BUSINESS

3.  Revised Vernon Housing Commission Procedures

  Public Works Director Wall presented the staff report.

  Melissa Ybarra expressed confusion on the process for relocation of existing
  tenants. She explained the benefit of transfers to the City , as transfers often result
  in increased rent.

  In response to questions, Public Works Director Wall discussed the means of
  advertising; application process for specific units; timing for the application period;
  online applications; annual review and Commission approval of procedures; and
  transfer unit request process.

MOTION
  Commissioner Edry moved and Commissioner Lopez seconded a motion to adopt
  revised New Tenant Lease Procedures and Occupant Relocation Procedures. The
  question was called and the motion carried 6-0, Chair Goff absent.

   Vernon Housing Commission Agenda Report

Meeting Date:  June 14, 2023
From:  Lisa Pope, City Clerk
Department:  City Clerk
Submitted by:  Lisa Pope, City Clerk

Subject
Housing Lotteries for City-Owned Housing

Recommendation
Conduct housing lotteries to establish randomized order to fill City-owned housing vacancies at
3390 50th Street (two-bedroom apartment), and 3560 Vernon Avenue (two-bedroom house).

Background
Pursuant to the New Tenant Lease Procedures, and to ensure that the selection process for new
tenants remains equitable and transparent, the City conducts a housing lottery when a City-
owned housing unit becomes available. The housing lottery is a random draw of all names on
the Housing Interest and Unit Transfer lists and establishes a randomized order by which a
vacancy shall be offered. The New Tenant Lease Procedures and housing lottery information are
available on the City's website at www.cityofvernon.org/housing.

Currently, the City has the following vacancies that require a lottery:
  • Two-bedroom apartment at 3390 50th Street; and
  • Two-bedroom house at 3560 Vernon Avenue.

Pursuant to New Tenant Lease Procedures Section 2, the Notice of Available Housing was
posted at City Hall on April 25, 2023; published in the Los Angeles Wave (Huntington Park
Bulletin) on April 27, 2023; widely publicized on the City's website and social media outlets; sent
via direct mail to Vernon businesses; provided to the Vernon Chamber of Commerce; and
advertised on Zillow (and Zillow affiliated websites). The new online interest form submission
system has yielded a tremendous response.

Per New Tenant Lease Procedures Section 3 and Occupant Relocation Procedures Section B,
all Interest Forms and Transfer Requests received by June 7, 2023, are included in the lotteries.

  Forms Received by June 7, 2023  Quantity

  Transfer Requests for 3390 50th Street  0
  Transfer Requests for 3560 Vernon Avenue  0
  Interest Forms for 3390 50th Street  106
  Interest Forms for 3560 Vernon Avenue  169

Two separate lotteries will be conducted for the two separate units. An Interest Confirmation List
for each of the lotteries is available online at: www.cityofvernon.org/VernonHousingLottery.

Fiscal Impact
There is no fiscal impact associated with this report.

Attachments

Housing Interest and Unit Transfer Request Forms are available on the City’s website at

information, contact the Public Works Department at (323) 826-1472.

cityofvernon.org/cityhousing.
